V-01.root_cause: adopt_partition locks its partition by rendered NAME (execute format('lock table %s ...', p_child::text), head install.sql ~14034), so when a concurrent session renames the partition and gives the name to a new table, committing while the call waits, LOCK TABLE re-resolves the name after the wait and locks the new table instead of p_child; the oid re-read passes and the row commits with no lock on the relation it records, so a DETACH commits first and pgpm.part records a standalone table as attached. Breaks the header's 'the relation judged attached is still attached when its row commits' and reference.md's 'the partition cannot be detached or dropped between the check and the row'. Reproduced on base and head with the classifier (READ COMMITTED; LIVENESS: the call is seen waiting on a Lock, records the oid, and holds 0 locks on it). Distinct by mechanism from #1262 (snapshot reads, closed by the PR's READ COMMITTED refusal) and from #1061 (capture fast path's handler for non-lockable relations). Tier 3 as #1262: bookkeeping wrong at commit, no rows lost. Finder's repro run unchanged.
